name: model-router
description: Routes each prompt to a model by how much thinking it needs: mechanical work to a cheap model, planning and design to a frontier one.

lightModel.title: Light model
lightModel.description: Model for mechanical, fully specified work (commit, push, rename, run tests, small defined edits).

deepModel.title: Deep model
deepModel.description: Model for planning, brainstorming, design, architecture and reviews.

standardModel.title: Standard model
standardModel.description: Model for everything else. Leave empty to use whatever /model is set to.

classifier.title: Use the classifier
classifier.description: When the rules can't tell, ask a small fast model to classify the prompt (adds a moment before those turns). Off: such prompts stay on the standard model.

maxLightMessages.title: Keep light work on the session model past this many messages
maxLightMessages.description: Prompt caching is per model, so on a long conversation the cheap model re-reads the whole history uncached, which can cost more than staying put.

escalateAfterSteps.title: Escalate a light turn after this many requests
escalateAfterSteps.description: A light task still going after this many model requests goes back to the standard model.
